name: Markotabödöge (Hungary)
description: White field with a row of red triangles along the top edge and a row of green triangles along the bottom edge, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Markotabödöge: a crowned red and green shield with a patriarchal cross and a church, within a green wreath, above a scroll inscribed MARKOTABÖDÖGE.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Markotabödöge arms with crown, wreath and scroll
